name: Kaishana
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Kaishana known only from wordlists (Hanke 1960, Nimuendaju 1955, Martius 1867) and comparative Arawak works (Ramirez); no stress description.

sources.citation: Aikhenvald, Alexandra Y. 1999. The Arawak language family. In Dixon & Aikhenvald (eds.), The Amazonian Languages, 65-106. Cambridge: CUP.
sources.note: Kaishana appears only in the language table (p.71, source Hanke 1960) and bibliography; the p.79 remark on contrastive stress lists other languages, not Kaishana.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid kais1242 and reference records 89236, 28294, 581555, 659746, 569683.
sources.note: n/a (bibliography; Glottolog's fullest description is only a wordlist).

sources.citation: Wikipedia (pt) 'Língua cauixana', Fonologia section citing Ramirez 2020 Enciclopédia das línguas Arawak vol. II.
sources.note: Third-hand: '21 fonemas.. vogais (6): i, e, a, o, i, V́' — i.e. Ramirez 2020 apparently counts a distinctive accent (V́) among Kauixana phonemes; no position rule given.
Kaixana only listed in classification tables; no data.

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri. 2001. Línguas Arawak da Amazônia Setentrional: Comparação e Descrição. Manaus: EDUA. §4.6.1 'Os Kauixana' pp.392-435; §5.2 p.468.
sources.harvard_location: Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number PM5476 .R36 2001
sources.note: Kauixana section gives only a phoneme list extracted from the old vocabularies (p t c k ts s h l r m n ɲ w j; a e i ɨ u) and grammar notes, nothing on accent; p.468 states explicitly that for lack of data and adequate descriptions of Warekena, Mandawaka, Kauixana etc. the accentual system will not be discussed.

sources.citation: Nimuendajú, Curt. 1955. Vocabularios Makuší, Wapičána, Ipurinã' e Kapišanã'. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 44: 179-197.
sources.note: Nothing; moreover the 'Kapišana'' list (pp.196-197, Rio Guarayú/Corumbiara, 1928) is Kanoê (Kapixaná), not Kaishana — Glottolog's assignment of this ref to kais1242 is a mis-link.

sources.citation: Martius, C. F. P. von. 1867. Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens II: Glossaria linguarum brasiliensium. Leipzig: Fleischer. 'Cauixana' list pp.257-259.
sources.note: Wordlist (Martius at Lake Acunauy, Spix at Tonantins) with accent marks on individual words; footnote p.257 only names collectors and Maypure affinity; no stress statement.
